ABORTED_IS_NOT_FAIL: This run produced NO verdict, in either direction. BCS is neither a PASS nor a FAIL. It is an experiment whose evaluation was terminated for resource reasons before its gate could be computed, and it must never be cited, tabulated, or summarised as a negative result.
REASON_STATEMENT: BCS was terminated without verdict following discovery that the incumbent had never undergone direct specialist-to-latent compression; resources were reallocated to the more fundamental preregistered teacher-distillation experiment.
REASON_IS_NOT: This was NOT stopped because an early number looked good or bad. The decision was made on provenance grounds -- see PROVENANCE_DISCOVERY below -- and the partial cell values below played no part in it.

PROVENANCE_DISCOVERY_THAT_CHANGED_THE_QU.found: ccp_successor_production_run_config.json and CCP_SUCCESSOR_MODEL_FROZEN.json#CONFIG_AND_SEED show the incumbent is a FRESH random-init PPO run (fresh_step_0=true, checkpoint_weights_loaded=false, total_timesteps=1000000, seed 11600001) with no causal-supervision coefficient present at all.
PROVENANCE_DISCOVERY_THAT_CHANGED_THE_QU.implication: pi_A and pi_B never entered that training run. The only specialist-derived signal ever applied to a latent network in this program is CCP-S2's sparse winner-directed causal bank (5 of 100 segments, 3.5x z0/z1 imbalance). No direct D_KL(pi_A||pi_theta(.|z0)) + D_KL(pi_B||pi_theta(.|z1)) compression has ever been run.
PROVENANCE_DISCOVERY_THAT_CHANGED_THE_QU.consequence: BCS, like CCP-S2 / RSCFT / trunk-freeze / SAC-RFT / Z-separation, is a repair applied to a policy that was never compressed from the specialists in the first place. The prior question (how to repair the compressed policy) was superseded by a more fundamental one (whether the compression itself can preserve crossover), which TEACHER_DISTILLATION_SPEC.json tests directly.
